This document defines writing and structure standards for the `docs` repo.
All developers and coding agents must follow these rules.

## General Guidelines

- Write for end users unless the page is explicitly internal.
- Use active voice and second person.
- Keep sentences concise and task-oriented.
- Prefer factual clarity over marketing language.

## Mintlify and MDX Rules

- Preserve valid MDX and frontmatter structure.
- Keep navigation intent aligned with `docs.json`.
- Use code fences with info strings when possible.
- Use backticks for commands, file paths, URLs, env vars, and code identifiers.
- Use bold for UI labels, buttons, and visible product text.

## Accuracy Rules

- Verify the source repo or product before documenting behavior.
- Do not merge behavior from different Fred repos unless the page explicitly compares them.
- Do not invent endpoints, flags, workflows, or screenshots.
- Call out missing source information instead of guessing.

## Style Rules

- Use sentence case for headings.
- Prefer short paragraphs and flat lists.
- Keep steps concrete and ordered when documenting workflows.
- Avoid jargon unless the domain genuinely requires it.
- Keep examples realistic and product-correct.
